messages:
Maya (Marketing): Heads-up: planning to publish benchmark + performance deep-dive on Thu 09:00 PT (embargoed). Need final asset pack, spokes, and a quick pre-brief at 08:20 PT. Who can join?
Priya (PR): 09:00 PT embargo ok for outreach. I'll manage media list and briefing calls. Can Noah join the pre-brief?
Noah (CEO): I can do 08:20-08:40 PT for a short pre-brief. Prefer to keep remarks focused on customer impact.
Evan (Eng): I'll prepare method notes, run commands, hardware list, and a 1200x600 perf PNG. Will upload before EOD Wed.
Clara (Legal): Reminder: avoid absolute superlatives ("fastest", "number one") unless we have substantiation. Send embargo copy for sign-off.
Maya (Marketing): Noted. Drafting 1-pager + two quote options for Noah. Rita, can you draft short social text?
Rita (Comms): On it. Two lengths: 280 and 140 chars. Also prepping internal explainer for CS/Support.
Jamal (Sales): I'll take enterprise media calls 09:30-10:30 PT. Please route any customer-specific questions to me.
Priya (PR): Call schedule tentatively: Noah 09:00-09:20, Evan 09:00-09:40, Jamal 09:30-10:30. I'll send calendar invites once assets are final.
publish-bot: Publish job queued for 2065439999. Reminder set. :robot_face:
Maya (Marketing): Ops note for eng-oncall: expect spike in traffic for first 10 minutes. Route traffic to canary pool first; auto-fallback to baseline pool if P95 latency > 600ms.
Evan (Eng): Will add a temporary perf alert and a rollback playbook. Also including run snippet for reproducibility: ```bash
./bench --model rwd-model-v2 --seq 1024 --runs 3 --batch 8
```
Clara (Legal): Approved embargo language with minor edits. Maya, send final paragraph for my sign-off.
Rita (Comms): Internal post draft ready. Will post to #announcements at publish time and ping support and sales.
Maya (Marketing): Checklist: 1) Final blog + PNG + CSV by Wed EOD; 2) Embargo text signed; 3) Press pack + invites; 4) 08:20 PT pre-brief; 5) Phone standby 09:00-10:30 PT.
Priya (PR): Also, no screenshots/copy to press before embargo lift. If anyone gets early outreach, direct to me.
Noah (CEO): Thanks all. Keep the brief under 15 minutes.
Maya (Marketing): Will do. I'll post when assets are uploaded. :rocket:
